Location: Stand 279, C Shed, Sydney Market, Flemington, NSW – 2129   
Salary: $82,000 plus 12% superannuation
Position: Full time, Permanent

Our client Evergreen Organic Wholesaler Pty Ptd trading as Evergreen Organic has grown rapidly as a trusted supplier of premium organic produce at Sydney Markets. Built on strong grower relationships and a team with deep industry experience, Evergreen Organic serves most of Sydney’s leading organic businesses and customers across Australia — prioritizing organic integrity, traceability and consistent quality. 

Evergreen Organic is seeking an experienced Quality Assurance Manager to lead food-safety, product quality and supplier compliance across market and warehouse operations. This is a managerial role with accountability for the company’s quality systems, organic certification integrity, supplier assurance, audit readiness and continuous improvement — a hands-on position with frequent supplier engagement at Sydney Markets.

Qualifications and Experience Requirements:

-	Relevant bachelor degree or equivalent qualification.
-	Minimum 1 year experience in quality assurance, food safety or quality management; experience in fresh produce, horticulture or perishable foods (especially organic) highly desirable.
-	Practical HACCP experience and proven track record managing food-safety systems and third-party audits.
-	Demonstrated experience with supplier audits, traceability, specification compliance and corrective action processes.
-	Familiarity with organic certification requirements (SXC and other relevant standards) and a practical understanding of maintaining organic integrity through the supply chain.
-	Experience using QA/ERP/CRM tools and strong Excel skills for KPI reporting.

Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

-	Own and maintain the company’s food-safety and quality management systems (HACCP/Food Safety Plan, QA documentation, traceability and recall procedures).
-	Lead and manage internal QA activity and coordinate all external audits/certifications (including SXC and other third-party standards such as Freshcare/HARPS where applicable).
-	Manage the supplier assurance program for organic produce — verify supplier organic certification, oversee onboarding, specification compliance, grower agreements and corrective actions.
-	Maintain organic integrity across the supply chain
-	Operate and continuously improve traceability systems and recall readiness; lead communications and corrective action for product quality incidents.
-	Perform product inspections, sampling and testing; lead non-conformance investigations, root-cause analysis and CAPA implementation.
-	Develop, monitor and present quality KPIs (rejects, complaints, supplier performance, cold-chain metrics) and provide actionable insights to management.
-	Work closely with Procurement, Operations and Customer Service to protect cold-chain integrity and ensure product specification adherence for specialty and seasonal ranges.
-	Manage QA documentation, SOP version control and compliance recordkeeping to support audits and regulatory requirements.
-	Drive continuous improvement projects to reduce waste, improve yield and enhance customer satisfaction.

Skills Requirements:

-	Strong attention to detail, excellent observational skills and a methodical investigative approach.
-	Confident communicator able to engage growers, suppliers and operational teams.
-	Proven ability to lead training, change management and continuous improvement initiatives.
-	Sound knowledge of food safety legislation and regulatory requirements (FSANZ/state health regulators) is an advantage.
-	Results-focused, with the ability to balance hands-on QA work and managerial oversight.

If you are a proactive and results-driven professional, we encourage you to apply! 

Please submit your resume to recruitment@targetbusiness.com.au.

The Client 

Blaze Engineering and Sheetmetal Fabrication Pty Ltd is a metal fabrication and engineering business based in Tullamarine, VIC, specialising in sheet metal fabrication, welding, metal assembly, and engineered manufacturing solutions.  

They are seeking an experienced Welder (First Class) to join their team in Tullamarine, VIC. 

 

The Role 

The Welder (First Class) is responsible for fabricating, assembling, and repairing metal components and structures using a range of welding and fabrication techniques. 

This is a full-time position with an annual salary of $78,000 to $82,000 plus superannuation. 

 

The Responsibilities 

Select and prepare appropriate welding equipment, consumables, and materials for welding operations. 

Read and interpret technical drawings, blueprints, welding procedures, and specifications to determine welding requirements. 

Mark out and cut metal sections and components using metal-cutting machinery. 

Shape and bend metal sections and plates using machine tools. 

Set up and operate MIG welding equipment to weld, join, and repair metal components and structures. 

Position and secure workpieces to ensure accurate alignment and welding in accordance with specifications. 

Perform welding operations on various metal components while maintaining required quality and safety standards. 

Inspect completed welds to ensure compliance with specified dimensions, quality requirements, and welding standards. 

Repair defective welds and damaged metal components through grinding, gouging, and rewelding processes. 

Perform weld finishing activities, including grinding and dressing welds to achieve the required finish and appearance. 

Use measuring and testing instruments to verify weld quality, accuracy, and compliance with specifications. 

Carry out welding repairs and maintenance on metal structures, machinery, equipment, and related components. 

Clean and prepare metal surfaces before and after welding to ensure quality. 

Conduct routine maintenance and basic troubleshooting of welding equipment to ensure safe and efficient operation. 

Follow workplace health and safety procedures, welding safety requirements, and relevant industry regulations at all times. 

Work collaboratively with supervisors, engineers, inspectors, and other trades personnel to complete welding tasks efficiently. 

Maintain accurate records of welding activities, inspections, repairs, materials used, and work completed. 

 

The Requirements 

Certificate IV in Engineering or equivalent qualification 

Minimum 1.5 years’ experience as a Welder (First Class) or within metal fabrication environments 

Minimum 1.5 years’ experience performing MIG welding across structural steel and fabricated metal components 

Minimum 1.5 years’ experience interpreting engineering drawings, fabrication plans, and technical specifications 

At least 1.5 years’ experience operating fabrication machinery, welding equipment, and metalworking tools 

At least 1.5 years’ experience assembling, repairing, and finishing fabricated metal products to engineering standards 

Sound knowledge of a range of welding techniques, including TIG, flux-cored and manual metal arc welding, and their application in metal fabrication. 

Strong knowledge of welding procedures, fabrication methods, and metal finishing techniques 

Ability to identify welding defects, dimensional inconsistencies, and fabrication issues accurately 

Strong understanding of workplace safety procedures, fabrication compliance standards, and workshop operations 

Good communication skills and ability to work effectively within fabrication and engineering teams 

High attention to detail and commitment to precision workmanship

UNI-SPAN HEIGHT SAFETY PTY LTD is the Australian entity of the broader Uni-Span Group, a specialist in formwork and scaffolding solutions for construction and infrastructure projects. Operating since at least 2006, the company provides and hires out Quickstage scaffolding systems, custom formwork solutions, and engineering support, serving industries such as civil, commercial, and power generation.

We are seeking skilled and qualified Scaffolders to join our team in NSW and QLD.

The role includes but is not limited to:
Determining job requirements and planning/configuring scaffolding
Undertake checking and assessing activities of scaffold prior to, during and at the completion of each build
Erecting lifting tackles by attaching pulleys and blocks to fixed overhead structures, and installing cables and attaching counterweights
Attaching slinging gear to hoisting equipment and objects to be moved using clamps, hooks, bolts and knots
Fitting and bolting tubes, support braces and components to form bases and build up scaffolding
Lifting and positioning sections of scaffolding
Carry out tasks within agreed time limits
Dismantling and removing on completion
Carry out tasks within agreed time limits
Fixing mesh and reinforcing steel into position in formwork for concrete pours
Setting up winches and rigging equipment to raise and position girders, plates, columns and other steel units
Erecting guard rails, guy wires, ropes and clears, laying planks and hanging safety nets
Help identify hazards, defects and the need for adjustment or repair; to ensure compliance with agreed codes, law, working practices and health and safety
Maintain accurate records of inspection and hand over
Where possible, rectify identified defects, failures, errors or omissions to scaffold structures. If not possible ensure reporting to the required personnel and restrict access to structure until such time the defect is rectified
Adhere to all organisational and customer policies, procedures and Safety Health Management System requirements
Ensure all scaffold, temporary works and other scaffold related activities are undertaken in accordance with Australian Standards and the relevant states Code of Practice

To be considered for this role, you must have the following:
Demonstratable working experience of at least 3 years in a similar role within the Construction and Maintenance industries
High Risk Work Licence (SB, SI or SA)
Proven experience erecting, maintaining and dismantling Scaffolding structures in the Port, Coal, Construction and Maintenance industries
Working at Heights Competency
Confined Space Entry Competency
Gas Test Atmospheres Competency
Coal Board Medical and Standard 11 Induction Competency
Desirable: Any or combination of Work Platform (WP), Forklift Truck (LF), Intermediate Rigger (RI), Dogger (DG) or Non-Slew Crane (CN) High Risk Work Licence/s
Construction Industry Induction – Blue/White Card
Ability to work well both independently and in a team environment
Strong communication skills
Strong commitment to hassle free customer service
Strong commitment to health, safety, environment and compliance standards
Willingness to work extended hours, shift work or hours as required to achieve positive outcomes
Desire to lead a highly driven team to achieve successful outcomes for both the customer and in turn, MI Scaffold
Self-motivated, organised, punctual and reliable
Must have great work ethics

If you meet the above criteria and would like to be considered for this position, please apply now!
Salary: Between $79,499 and $82,000 per annum + Super
